deglazingLiquids.name: Chilled Cooking Wine / Cold Tap Water (15°C / 59°F)
deglazingLiquids.description: Typical commercial kitchen deglazing liquid; produces immediate steam plumes, oil spitting, and substantial localized bottom contraction.

deglazingLiquids.name: Ambient Kitchen Stock / Broth (25°C / 77°F)
deglazingLiquids.description: Room-temperature culinary broth held in kitchen prep station; moderate thermal shock that remains safe if pan temperature is kept below 200°C.

deglazingLiquids.name: Pre-Heated Hot Stock / Simmering Liquid (85°C / 185°F, OSHA/Culinary Gold Standard)
deglazingLiquids.description: Professional culinary best practice; minimises ΔT to less than 120°C, preventing thermal shock warping, reducing violent boiling splattering, and preserving braising pan metallurgical integrity.

engineeringStandards.title: Commercial Cooking, Rethermalization, and Powered Hot Food Holding and Transport Equipment
engineeringStandards.requirement: Section 5.3 mandates that tilting braising pans must incorporate smooth, seamless pouring lips with positive splash containment, a controlled pour rate not exceeding 3 degrees per second under power tilt, and food contact surfaces free from open seams, internal crevices, or permanent warping exceeding 1/16" (1.59 mm) per foot.

engineeringStandards.title: Walking-Working Surfaces & General Requirements for Personal Protective Equipment
engineeringStandards.requirement: Mandates slip-resistant drainage catch basins under commercial tilting equipment, elimination of hot liquid discharge directly onto walking walkways, and mandatory high-temperature thermal/fluid PPE (mid-arm gauntlet gloves and full-face splash shields) during manual pouring and deglazing operations.

engineeringStandards.title: Rules for Construction of Pressure Vessels & Flat Heat-Transfer Surfaces
engineeringStandards.requirement: Calculates allowable thermal gradient stresses (σ_th = E·α·ΔT / (1 - ν)) to prevent plastic permanent deformation of flat bottom plates under localized cyclic thermal shock and burner flame impingement.

engineeringStandards.title: Standard for Ventilation Control and Fire Protection of Commercial Cooking Operations
engineeringStandards.requirement: Requires minimum 18" (457 mm) clearance between grease-laden tilting pan lip travel envelopes and exhaust hood filters, with automatic burner fuel shutoff interlocked when the pan is tilted past 10 degrees from horizontal.
